subject: english
label: 英検ライティング 定型表現
blurb: 意見文とEメールで使い回せる型を、日本語から英文にして打つ。3級〜準1級
audience: 試験の英作文対策をする中学生・高校生・社会人

words.answer: I think students should read more books.
accept: I think that students should read more books.
words.q: 私は生徒はもっと本を読むべきだと思います。
words.explain: 英作文の型の1文目。I think (that)＋主張。should で「べき」を明示すると意見文らしくなる
words.say: I think students should read more books.

words.answer: In my opinion, students should wear school uniforms.
accept: In my opinion, students should wear uniforms.
words.ja: 立場表明 In my opinion
words.q: 私の意見では、生徒は制服を着るべきです。
words.explain: In my opinion, の後にカンマ。I think と重ねて In my opinion, I think とは言わない
words.say: In my opinion, students should wear school uniforms.

words.answer: I do not agree with this idea.
accept: I don't agree with this idea.
I disagree with this idea.
words.q: 私はこの考えには賛成しません。
words.explain: agree with＋考え／人。agree to は提案に応じる。反対の立場を1文目で明確にする型
words.say: I do not agree with this idea.

words.answer: I have two reasons.
accept: I have two reasons for this.
I have two reasons to support this opinion.
words.q: 理由は2つあります。（I で始めて）
words.explain: 立場表明の直後に置く定型。数字は英単語 two。この後 First, … Second, … と続ける
words.say: I have two reasons.

words.answer: I agree with the idea that children should learn English.
accept: I agree that children should learn English.
words.q: 私は子どもは英語を学ぶべきだという考えに賛成です。
words.explain: the idea that＋文（同格の that）。設問の文をそのまま that 以下に入れれば1文目が書ける
words.say: I agree with the idea that children should learn English.

words.answer: I believe that people should use less plastic.
accept: I believe people should use less plastic.
words.q: 私は人々はプラスチックの使用を減らすべきだと信じています。
words.explain: I believe は I think より強い確信。less＋数えられない名詞（plastic）。fewer は可算名詞に
words.say: I believe that people should use less plastic.

words.answer: It is better for children to play outside.
accept: It's better for children to play outside.
words.ja: 立場表明 It is better
words.q: 子どもは外で遊ぶほうがよいです。（It で始めて）
words.explain: 「〜するほうがよい」は It is better for 人 to do。主語を Children にせず It で始める型
words.say: It is better for children to play outside.

words.answer: I do not think this is true.
accept: I don't think this is true.
I do not think that this is true.
I don't think that this is true.
words.ja: 立場表明（否定は think に）
words.q: 私はこれが本当だとは思いません。
words.explain: 英語では否定を think 側に置く（I don't think …）。I think this is not true は不自然
words.say: I do not think this is true.

words.answer: I strongly believe that this is a good idea.
accept: I strongly believe this is a good idea.
words.q: 私はこれがよい考えだと強く信じています。
words.explain: 副詞 strongly は believe の前。very believe は誤り。準1級では firmly believe も使える
words.say: I strongly believe that this is a good idea.

words.answer: Personally, I think online classes are useful.
accept: Personally, I think that online classes are useful.
Personally, I think online classes are helpful.
words.q: 個人的には、オンライン授業は役に立つと思います。
words.explain: Personally, の後にカンマ。「私にとって」を For me だけで済ませず Personally, I think が定型
words.say: Personally, I think online classes are useful.

words.answer: First, reading books helps students learn new words.
accept: First, reading books helps students to learn new words.
Firstly, reading books helps students learn new words.
words.q: 第一に、本を読むことは生徒が新しい単語を学ぶのに役立ちます。
words.explain: First, の後にカンマ。動名詞主語は単数扱い（helps）。help＋人＋(to) 動詞の原形
words.say: First, reading books helps students learn new words.

words.answer: Second, books are cheaper than video games.
accept: Secondly, books are cheaper than video games.
words.q: 第二に、本はテレビゲームより安いです。
words.explain: First, と Second, をそろえる（First と Secondly を混ぜない）。「テレビゲーム」は video games
words.say: Second, books are cheaper than video games.

words.answer: First of all, exercise is good for our health.
words.q: まず第一に、運動は私たちの健康によいです。
words.explain: First of all, は First, より強い切り出し。be good for＋名詞。健康は health（数えない）
words.say: First of all, exercise is good for our health.

words.answer: Also, students can make many friends there.
accept: Also, students can make a lot of friends there.
words.q: また、生徒はそこでたくさんの友達を作ることができます。
words.explain: Also, を文頭に置いて理由を足す。「友達を作る」は make friends（get は不自然）
words.say: Also, students can make many friends there.

words.answer: Another reason is that they can save money.
words.q: もう一つの理由は、彼らはお金を節約できるということです。
words.explain: Another reason is that＋文。is because は避け、is that を使う。「節約する」は save
words.say: Another reason is that they can save money.

words.answer: One reason is that it is good for the environment.
accept: One reason is that it's good for the environment.
words.q: 一つの理由は、それが環境によいということです。
words.explain: One reason is that … Another reason is that … の組み合わせ。the environment に the を付ける
words.say: One reason is that it is good for the environment.

words.answer: This is because they can practice speaking every day.
accept: That is because they can practice speaking every day.
words.q: これは、彼らが毎日話す練習ができるからです。
words.explain: 主張の直後に This is because＋文で理由を足す。practice＋動名詞（practice to speak は誤り）
words.say: This is because they can practice speaking every day.

words.answer: Finally, cooking at home is healthier.
accept: Lastly, cooking at home is healthier.
words.q: 最後に、家で料理するほうが健康的です。
words.explain: 3つ目の理由は Finally, か Lastly,。At last は「ついに」なので不可。healthier の比較級
words.say: Finally, cooking at home is healthier.

words.answer: In addition, walking does not cost any money.
accept: In addition, walking doesn't cost any money.
In addition, walking costs no money.
In addition, walking costs nothing.
words.q: さらに、歩くことにはお金が全くかかりません。（In addition を使って）
words.explain: In addition, ＝ Also, のやや硬い形。cost は「費用がかかる」で目的語に money。need money とも言える
words.say: In addition, walking does not cost any money.

words.answer: For example, I read a book every night.
accept: For instance, I read a book every night.
words.q: 例えば、私は毎晩本を読みます。
words.explain: 理由の直後に For example, ＋自分の体験。every night は毎晩なので現在形 read
words.say: For example, I read a book every night.

words.answer: I like sports such as soccer and tennis.
words.q: 私はサッカーやテニスなどのスポーツが好きです。（such as を使って）
words.explain: 名詞＋such as＋例。such as の前後に文は置けない（For example は文頭）。and so on は不要
words.say: I like sports such as soccer and tennis.

words.answer: When I was a child, I often played in the park.
accept: When I was a kid, I often played in the park.
words.q: 私が子どもの頃、よく公園で遊びました。
words.explain: 体験談は過去形。often は一般動詞の前。a child の冠詞を忘れない
words.say: When I was a child, I often played in the park.

words.answer: In my case, I study English by watching movies.
accept: In my case, I study English by watching films.
words.q: 私の場合、映画を見て英語を勉強しています。
words.explain: In my case, で自分の例に切り替える。「〜して」の手段は by＋動名詞
words.say: In my case, I study English by watching movies.

words.answer: For instance, many students use smartphones to study.
accept: For instance, many students use smartphones for studying.
words.q: 例えば、多くの生徒は勉強にスマートフォンを使います。（For instance で）
words.explain: For instance, は For example, と同じ。同じ文中で2回使うときの言い換えに。to study は目的
words.say: For instance, many students use smartphones to study.

words.answer: A good example is my school library.
words.q: よい例は私の学校の図書館です。（A good example で始めて）
words.explain: A good example is＋名詞。例が名詞1語で済むときに便利。example の綴りに注意
words.say: A good example is my school library.

words.answer: A friend of mine goes to the gym every day.
accept: One of my friends goes to the gym every day.
words.q: 私の友人の一人は毎日ジムに行っています。
words.explain: 「友人の一人」は a friend of mine。a my friend は誤り。3人称単数なので goes
words.say: A friend of mine goes to the gym every day.

words.answer: Take my brother, for example.
words.q: 私の兄を例に挙げましょう。（Take で始めて）
words.explain: Take＋名詞, for example. で例を切り出し、次の文で説明する。for example が文末に来る形
words.say: Take my brother, for example.

words.answer: Some people say that video games are bad for children.
accept: Some people say video games are bad for children.
words.q: テレビゲームは子どもに悪いと言う人もいます。
words.explain: 「〜という人もいる」は Some people say (that)。There are people who … より簡潔
words.say: Some people say that video games are bad for children.

words.answer: However, I do not think so.
accept: However, I don't think so.
words.q: しかし、私はそうは思いません。（However で始めて）
words.explain: However, の後にカンマ。But で文を始めるより However, が英作文向き。so で前文を受ける
words.say: However, I do not think so.

words.answer: It is true that cars are convenient.
accept: It's true that cars are convenient.
words.ja: 譲歩 It is true that
words.q: 確かに車は便利です。（It is true で始めて）
words.explain: 「確かに〜」は It is true that＋文。必ず次に However, で反論を続けるセット
words.say: It is true that cars are convenient.

words.answer: However, they cause a lot of air pollution.
accept: However, they cause much air pollution.
However, they cause a great deal of air pollution.
words.q: しかし、それらは多くの大気汚染を引き起こします。
words.explain: It is true that … の後に続ける反論。pollution は数えられない名詞なので many は不可
words.say: However, they cause a lot of air pollution.

words.answer: Some people may think that money is the most important thing.
accept: Some people may think money is the most important thing.
Some people might think that money is the most important thing.
words.q: お金が最も大切なものだと考える人もいるかもしれません。
words.explain: may think で「〜と考えるかもしれない」と一歩引いて示す。最上級 the most important thing
words.say: Some people may think that money is the most important thing.

words.answer: On the other hand, living in the city is expensive.
accept: On the other hand, living in a city is expensive.
words.q: 一方で、都市に住むのは費用が高いです。
words.explain: On the other hand, は対比。反論ではなく別の面を示す。動名詞主語 living は単数扱い
words.say: On the other hand, living in the city is expensive.

words.answer: Although smartphones are useful, they can be dangerous.
words.q: スマートフォンは便利ですが、危険なこともあります。（Although で始めて）
words.explain: Although＋文, 主節。Although … , but と but を重ねない。「〜なこともある」は can be
words.say: Although smartphones are useful, they can be dangerous.
accept: Although smartphones are useful, they can also be dangerous.

words.answer: I understand this opinion, but I disagree.
accept: I understand this opinion, but I do not agree.
I understand this opinion, but I don't agree.
words.q: この意見は理解できますが、私は反対です。
words.explain: understand＋名詞で相手の意見を認めてから but で反論。can understand と言わなくてよい
words.say: I understand this opinion, but I disagree.

words.answer: Nevertheless, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
accept: Nevertheless, I believe that the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
Nevertheless, I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
words.q: それでもなお、私は長所が短所を上回ると信じています。
words.explain: Nevertheless, は However, より強い「それでもなお」。outweigh＝上回る（準1級の定番動詞）
words.say: Nevertheless, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.

words.answer: For these reasons, I think students should read more books.
accept: For these reasons, I think that students should read more books.
words.q: これらの理由から、私は生徒はもっと本を読むべきだと思います。
words.explain: 最後の文は For these reasons, ＋1文目の主張をくり返す。reasons は複数形
words.say: For these reasons, I think students should read more books.

words.answer: That is why I like living in the countryside.
accept: That's why I like living in the countryside.
That is why I like living in the country.
words.q: だから私は田舎に住むのが好きなのです。（That is why を使って）
words.explain: That is why＋結果の文。「だから」を So だけで始めるより締まる。like＋動名詞
words.say: That is why I like living in the countryside.

words.answer: Therefore, I agree with this opinion.
accept: Therefore, I agree with this idea.
words.q: したがって、私はこの意見に賛成です。
words.explain: Therefore, の後にカンマ。So より書き言葉向き。agree with＋意見
words.say: Therefore, I agree with this opinion.

words.answer: In conclusion, I believe that this plan will succeed.
accept: In conclusion, I believe this plan will succeed.
To conclude, I believe that this plan will succeed.
To conclude, I believe this plan will succeed.
words.q: 結論として、私はこの計画は成功すると信じています。
words.explain: In conclusion, は長めの意見文の締め。succeed は自動詞なので目的語を取らない
words.say: In conclusion, I believe that this plan will succeed.

words.answer: For these two reasons, I do not agree with this idea.
accept: For these two reasons, I don't agree with this idea.
For these two reasons, I disagree with this idea.
words.q: これら2つの理由から、私はこの考えに賛成しません。
words.explain: For these two reasons, と数を入れると理由が2つだと明示できる。1文目の否定文をくり返す
words.say: For these two reasons, I do not agree with this idea.

words.answer: In short, exercise makes us healthy and happy.
words.q: 要するに、運動は私たちを健康で幸せにします。
words.explain: In short, は要約の合図。make＋人＋形容詞（makes us healthy）。健康な＝healthy
words.say: In short, exercise makes us healthy and happy.

words.answer: To sum up, I think online shopping is convenient.
accept: To sum up, I think that online shopping is convenient.
words.q: まとめると、私はオンラインショッピングは便利だと思います。（To sum up で始めて）
words.explain: To sum up, ＝ In conclusion,。online shopping は数えられない名詞。convenient の綴り
words.say: To sum up, I think online shopping is convenient.

words.answer: I hope more people will think about this problem.
accept: I hope that more people will think about this problem.
I hope more people think about this problem.
words.q: もっと多くの人がこの問題について考えてくれることを願っています。
words.explain: 結論のあとに添える一文。hope＋文（hope 人 to do は誤り）。think about＋名詞
words.say: I hope more people will think about this problem.

words.answer: Thank you for your e-mail.
accept: Thanks for your e-mail.
words.q: あなたのメールをありがとうございます。
words.explain: 返信メールの1文目の定型。Thank you for＋名詞。email でも e-mail でも可
words.say: Thank you for your e-mail.

words.answer: I am glad to hear that you passed the test.
accept: I'm glad to hear that you passed the test.
I am glad to hear you passed the test.
I'm glad to hear you passed the test.
I am happy to hear that you passed the test.
words.ja: Eメール 相手の話への反応
words.q: あなたがテストに合格したと聞いてうれしいです。
words.explain: 相手のメールの内容に触れる型。glad to hear (that)＋文。「合格する」は pass
words.say: I am glad to hear that you passed the test.

words.answer: I have two questions.
accept: I have two questions for you.
words.ja: Eメール 質問の予告
words.q: 質問が2つあります。（I で始めて）
words.explain: 質問を2つ書く前に置く定型。次の文から疑問文を2つ続ける。数字は two
words.say: I have two questions.

words.answer: I am looking forward to seeing you soon.
accept: I'm looking forward to seeing you soon.
I look forward to seeing you soon.
words.q: もうすぐあなたに会えるのを楽しみにしています。
words.explain: look forward to＋動名詞。to see は誤り（この to は前置詞）。結びの定番
words.say: I am looking forward to seeing you soon.

words.answer: I am sorry for my late reply.
accept: I'm sorry for my late reply.
I am sorry for the late reply.
Sorry for my late reply.
words.q: 返事が遅くなってごめんなさい。
words.explain: sorry for＋名詞。「返事」は reply（answer も可だが reply が定型）。late は形容詞で reply の前
words.say: I am sorry for my late reply.

words.answer: How long have you been playing the guitar?
accept: How long have you played the guitar?
words.q: あなたはどのくらいギターを弾いているのですか。
words.explain: 続けている期間を聞くときは How long＋現在完了。楽器には the。疑問符を忘れない
words.say: How long have you been playing the guitar?

words.answer: Let me know if you have any questions.
accept: Please let me know if you have any questions.
words.ja: Eメール 結びの一言
words.q: 何か質問があれば教えてください。（Let me で始めて）
words.explain: let me know＝知らせて。if 節は現在形。any questions と複数形にするのが自然
words.say: Let me know if you have any questions.

words.answer: Please tell me more about your trip.
words.ja: Eメール 詳しく聞く
words.q: あなたの旅行についてもっと教えてください。
words.explain: tell＋人＋more about＋名詞。teach は勉強を教えるときだけ。「旅行」は trip
words.say: Please tell me more about your trip.

words.answer: I hope to hear from you soon.
accept: I look forward to hearing from you soon.
words.ja: Eメール 返信を促す
words.q: すぐにお返事をもらえるとうれしいです。（hear を使って）
words.explain: hear from＋人＝〜から連絡をもらう。hope to do。手紙・メールの結びの定型
words.say: I hope to hear from you soon.

words.answer: Please say hello to your family.
accept: Please say hi to your family.
Say hello to your family for me.
words.ja: Eメール よろしく伝える
words.q: ご家族によろしくお伝えください。
words.explain: 「よろしく伝えて」は say hello to＋人。tell your family hello とは言わない
words.say: Please say hello to your family.

words.answer: In today's society, many people suffer from stress.
accept: In today's society, a lot of people suffer from stress.
In modern society, many people suffer from stress.
words.q: 今日の社会では、多くの人がストレスに苦しんでいます。
words.explain: 社会問題の導入に使う。suffer from＋名詞。stress は数えられない名詞
words.say: In today's society, many people suffer from stress.

words.answer: This will have a positive effect on the economy.
accept: This will have a good effect on the economy.
It will have a positive effect on the economy.
words.q: これは経済によい影響を与えるでしょう。（effect を使って）
words.explain: have a positive/negative effect on＋名詞。effect は名詞、affect は動詞。give an effect は誤り
words.say: This will have a positive effect on the economy.

words.answer: It is often argued that technology makes our lives easier.
accept: It's often argued that technology makes our lives easier.
It is often said that technology makes our lives easier.
words.q: テクノロジーは私たちの生活を楽にするとよく主張されます。
words.explain: 一般論を示して反論につなげる型。受動態 is argued。our lives と複数形（life の複数）
words.say: It is often argued that technology makes our lives easier.

words.answer: This will lead to a healthier society.
words.q: これはより健康な社会につながるでしょう。（lead を使って）
words.explain: lead to＋名詞＝〜につながる。to の後に動詞は置けない。結果を述べる準1級の定番
words.say: This will lead to a healthier society.

words.answer: Education plays an important role in our society.
accept: Education plays an important role in society.
Education plays an important part in our society.
words.q: 教育は私たちの社会で重要な役割を果たしています。
words.explain: play a role in＋名詞。「果たす」に do は使わない。education は数えられない名詞
words.say: Education plays an important role in our society.

words.answer: There is no doubt that exercise improves our health.
accept: There's no doubt that exercise improves our health.
words.q: 運動が私たちの健康を向上させることは疑いありません。
words.explain: There is no doubt that＋文＝疑いなく。improve は他動詞で目的語をとる
words.say: There is no doubt that exercise improves our health.

words.answer: Recycling contributes to protecting the environment.
accept: Recycling contributes to the protection of the environment.
Recycling contributes to environmental protection.
words.q: リサイクルは環境を守ることに貢献します。（contribute を使って）
words.explain: contribute to＋名詞／動名詞。この to は前置詞なので to protect は誤り
words.say: Recycling contributes to protecting the environment.

words.answer: It is essential for governments to invest in education.
accept: It's essential for governments to invest in education.
It is essential that governments invest in education.
words.q: 政府が教育に投資することは不可欠です。（It is essential で始めて）
words.explain: It is essential for 人 to do。that 節なら動詞は原形（invest）。invest in＋名詞
words.say: It is essential for governments to invest in education.

words.answer: More and more people are working from home.
accept: More and more people work from home.
words.q: ますます多くの人が在宅で働いています。
words.explain: 「ますます多くの人」は More and more people。進行形で今の流れを表す。work from home が定型
words.say: More and more people are working from home.

words.answer: The number of foreign tourists is increasing.
accept: The number of foreign tourists is growing.
The number of foreign visitors is increasing.
words.q: 外国人観光客の数は増えています。
words.explain: The number of＋複数名詞＋is（単数扱い）。a number of は「多くの」で複数扱い。増える＝increase
words.say: The number of foreign tourists is increasing.

words.answer: These days, many young people do not read newspapers.
accept: These days, many young people don't read newspapers.
words.q: 最近、多くの若者は新聞を読みません。（These days で始めて）
words.explain: 「最近」は現在形なら these days。recently は過去・現在完了と使う。newspapers と複数形
words.say: These days, many young people do not read newspapers.

words.answer: The number of children in Japan is decreasing.
accept: The number of children in Japan is falling.
The number of children in Japan is going down.
words.q: 日本の子どもの数は減っています。
words.explain: 減る＝decrease／fall／go down。children は複数形。動詞は The number に合わせて is
words.say: The number of children in Japan is decreasing.

words.answer: Compared with the past, people live much longer now.
accept: Compared to the past, people live much longer now.
Compared with the past, people live much longer today.
words.q: 昔と比べて、人々は今ずっと長生きしています。（Compared で始めて）
words.explain: Compared with/to＋名詞, 文。比較級の強調は much（very longer は誤り）
words.say: Compared with the past, people live much longer now.

words.answer: According to a survey, about half of students have smartphones.
accept: According to a survey, about half of the students have smartphones.
According to one survey, about half of students have smartphones.
words.q: ある調査によると、生徒の約半数がスマートフォンを持っています。
words.explain: According to＋出典で数字に説得力を出す。half of＋複数名詞は複数扱い（have）
words.say: According to a survey, about half of students have smartphones.

words.answer: About thirty percent of high school students have part-time jobs.
accept: Around thirty percent of high school students have part-time jobs.
About thirty percent of high school students have a part-time job.
About thirty percent of high school students work part-time.
words.q: 高校生の約30パーセントがアルバイトをしています。
words.explain: percent は単複同形。〜 percent of＋複数名詞は複数扱い。「アルバイト」は part-time job
words.say: About thirty percent of high school students have part-time jobs.

words.answer: Twice as many people visited Japan as ten years ago.
accept: Twice as many people visited Japan as they did ten years ago.
words.q: 10年前の2倍の人が日本を訪れました。
words.explain: twice as many＋複数名詞＋as。数えられない量なら twice as much。数字は英単語 ten
words.say: Twice as many people visited Japan as ten years ago.
